title: Keep Her Centred in Portrait
tests: Tests portrait reframing of existing footage while preserving the speaker, duration and source audio.

judge.summary: The clip is cleanly reframed to 9:16 with the woman centred, her full head visible, and no added text or visible defects.

must_haves.item: The output is a 9:16 video using the attached woman's actual footage, not a newly generated recreation.
must_haves.why: The portrait frames match the source woman's appearance, clothing, and setting, with no visible recreation artifacts.

must_haves.item: The woman remains horizontally centred with her face and head comfortably visible throughout.
must_haves.why: She is horizontally centred with her entire head and comfortable headroom in all four sampled frames.

must_haves.item: The picture fills the portrait frame without stretching or black bars.
must_haves.why: The image fills the 9:16 frame edge to edge, and her proportions appear natural.

must_haves.item: The full 10-second sequence and original speech are retained in sync.
must_haves.why: The reported 10.1-second video and 10-second speech track support the requested duration, but still frames and an output-only transcript cannot verify original-audio identity or lip sync.

must_haves.item: No captions or other text have been added.
must_haves.why: No captions, titles, or other added text appear in the supplied output frames.
